questions.question: ‘Chickenpox’ is related to ‘Virus’ in the same way as ‘Ringworm’ is related to ‘________’.
questions.solution:

Similarly,

Ringworm is caused by Fungus.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Fungus"**.

questions.question:
Select the number-pair in which the two numbers are related in the same way as are the two numbers of the following number-pair.

7 : 85
questions.solution:
The logic is:

7 : 85 

(7 × 7) + 6² = 49 + 36 = 85

Similarly,

8 : 113

(8 × 8) + 72 = 64 + 49 = 113

The correct answer is 8 : 113.

questions.question:
Three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All rocks are oceans.

All oceans are balloons.

Some watches are balloons.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some balloons are rocks.

II. Some watches are oceans.

III. All oceans are rocks.

options.text: Only conclusions I and II follow.
Only conclusions I and III follow.

questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/348f982b0f11da79622a28648c7ff0060dd4610e466d7b8200b60c592ba2a0d8.png] 

Concept:

1) We have to check the conclusions are 100% match with the statement. If the conclusion is 100% match with the given statement then the conclusion is true. If there is a 1% chance of not following the statement then the conclusion is considered to be false.

2) The possibility case can be considered to be "false" in "definite case".

3) In Possibility case, either "can" or "possible" word must be present.

the correct answer is option 3 i.e. Only conclusion I follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/45d0e2b3c3f3bfd0c1b112f92114484e675513633c7e78be2c250397c6f1d4d8.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. Some balloons are rocks → True.

II. Some watches are oceans → False (As per diagram, no relation is between watches and oceans)

III. All oceans are rocks → False (Some oceans are rocks is true)

Hence, the correct answer is Only conclusion I follows.

questions.question: A plastic toy costs Rs. 7 and a plastic spoon costs Rs. 5. A person X spends Rs. 38 on these plastic items. Find the number of plastic toys he/she purchased.
questions.solution:
EXPLANATION:

The purchase value of 1 plastic toy and spoon = Rs. 7 + Rs. 5 = Rs. 12

Now, Value of 2 Plastic toys and 2 Spoon = 12 × 2 = Rs. 24

Given, X spends Rs. 38

Remaining amount (after purchasing 2 Plastic toys and 2 Spoon) = 38 – 24 = Rs. 14

So, only 2 plastic toys can be purchased from the above amount.

∴ Required number of Plastic toys = 2 + 2 = 4

Hence, the correct answer is **"4"**.

 [IMAGE: https://lh6.googleusercontent.com/Xb-iJKnXypAfBJ6eEsWi03DkkAC8Nndi_HWNG353QhMaAwzLs0wQ2A5sN5KMS2q738zEBstPjNUcPl5-gpW4ohEgfQ2rBfw4Sy40kTGGxnBWmgi8lczTbU_dnnoSgemTzMUyqDES] 

In this question, a Number of plastic toys were asked (not total number of plastic items). 

Here Total number of plastic items = 6

Total number of plastic toys = 4

 

 [IMAGE: https://lh6.googleusercontent.com/UnUy2Vi0WIGS6Ggu0fgG0shcmK0tOLA7NgKjwWM_ZfJcTGQmyQWJ1NuY76AFfYVLS7FTobv8vKRpUDnhFCViGT1iBysghvkA74lcxxwJYQjOLwe028sm5RKPjccZawUneQDoPp7-] 

Go through the options:

**Option 1:**

4 Plastic toys costs Rs. 4 × 7 = Rs. 28

Remaining Amount (38 - 28) = Rs. 10

Plastic spoon costs Rs. 5 per item

Since 10 is divisible by 5

∴ Option 1 is correct.
